event_name: Date 08 July 2018 Time 14:54 2018 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between car 8 and car 20 in Turn 3.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 as defined by the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, and found that the incident occurring in front of the two cars influenced both, and subsequently the cars collided. Therefore the Stewards took no further action. All
stewards: as set out in the International Sporting Code
title: Doc 43 2018 British Grand Prix Decision Car 8 Incident With Car 20
